cases.title: Two separate shipments, amendment, retry and late original
cases.scope: Authored checkpoint reference v1; shipment/document identity exact; agreed fields only; invoice-ready is an illustrative operator label, not a compliance determination.

steps.title: Two distinct bookings sharing a weak container reference
steps.scenario: Keep the two booking/document identities separate. Preserve a reviewed locked consignee and an exact large numeric reference.

steps.title: Accepted quantity amendment
steps.scenario: Observe revision2 of BOOK-A changing quantity from100 to90; retain the same shipment and protected fields.

steps.title: Duplicate delivery of the same amendment
steps.scenario: Deliver the same amend-a event again; the resulting state must still match the accepted amendment.

steps.title: Late delivery of original booking
steps.scenario: After revision2, deliver revision1 of BOOK-A. The selected approved state remains90; the older observation should not replace it.

review.note: Reviewed fictional reference against the authored input sequence. No provider service or customer outputs used.
